extDescription.message: Two dubs of one video at once: one in the left ear, another in the right

commandToggle.message: Turn Dual Dub on or off

step1Description.message: Click the site player and start the episode

step2Title.message: Pick a dub for one ear

step2Description.message: The list on the left or right ear

step3Title.message: Pick a dub for the other ear

step3SwitchDescription.message: Switch the dub in the site player and it shows up in the list

step4Description.message: Use the switch at the top

emptyDescription.message: Open a page with a video player

alertSuspendedTitle.message: Sound is waiting for a click

alertSilentDescription.message: The site may block this dub. Pick another one for this ear

alertSameDescription.message: Pick another dub for one ear

alertNoVideoDescription.message: Start the video in the player and turn on again

alertFailedDescription.message: Reload the page and try again

permissionDescription.message: Without it the extension cannot see the dubs in the player
